STARS IN BANDED VIOLET: the long slot open on a tall strip of banded violet night crowded with stars, one cold bright patch lying along one dome rib and across the floorboards below
STARS IN DEEP BLUE BANDS: the slot standing open on banded deep blue night, stars crowding it from edge to edge, their cold light lying in a pale wash along one timber rib
STARS EDGE TO EDGE: the slot open wide on a dithered violet and indigo strip packed with stars, the brightest a flat bright pixel, its cold light catching on one dome rib
STARS AND ONE BRIGHT PIXEL: the slot open on banded night in deep blues, one star burning flat and bright at its centre, cold light lying in a scatter across the boards below
STARS IN VIOLET GRADIENT: the slot standing open on a tall dithered strip, blues deepening to violet at the top, stars crowding both edges, a cold pale wash lying on the plaster inside
OVERSIZED MOON CROSSING SLOW: a flat pixel disc far too wide for the slot crossing it slowly, so bright the room holds two lights, cold pale edges catching on the brass inside
MOON FILLING THE SLOT: the oversized flat disc of the moon sitting squarely in the slot, flooding the room in pale cold light, every brass fitting taking a bright edge along one side
MOON HALFWAY PAST: the flat pixel moon halfway across the slot, its cold light doubled on the floorboards, one dome rib lit pale and sharp on the side facing the opening
MOON LOW IN THE SLOT: the flat pale disc low in the tall strip of night, its cold light pouring in and lying in a broad pale wash across the boards and up the near plaster wall
COMET STANDING UPRIGHT: one comet standing tall in the strip of night, its long soft tail leaning back into the dark, pale light catching on the dome boards along both sides of the slot
COMET TAIL LEANING LEFT: one comet in the slot's strip of night, tail leaning gently left, its pale cold glow lying softly on the timber ribs and in a faint wash on the boards below
COMET NEAR THE TOP: one comet high in the tall strip of night, its soft tail stretching downward, pale light from it lying faintly on the plaster inside the slot's mouth
COMET AND CROWDED STARS: one comet standing in the slot among crowded stars, its soft tail leaning back, pale light catching on the dome boards and glowing faintly on the near wall
AURORA FOLDS IN GREEN AND ROSE: soft green and rose folds moving slowly in the tall strip of night, their colour reaching in and lying faintly on the pale plaster inside the slot's mouth
AURORA PALE GREEN: a pale green aurora folding slowly in the slot's strip of sky, its glow washing in and lying in a faint cool green across the plaster and the near timber rib
AURORA ROSE AND VIOLET: rose and violet folds moving in the strip of night, soft colour spilling in through the slot and lying gently on the plaster inside, fading toward the far wall
AURORA OVER STARS: soft green aurora folds moving in the slot above a crowd of stars, green light reaching in and lying faintly on the boards and up the plaster at the slot's mouth
FAT SLOW SNOW DRIFTING: fat slow snowflakes drifting down through the open slot in flat pixel dots, settling in a thin white line along one dome rib and a small drift on the boards
SNOW ALONG THE RIB: fat pixel snowflakes drifting in through the slot and settling, a thin white line built along one rib, a small cold heap gathering on the floorboards directly below
SNOW IN VIOLET NIGHT: fat slow flat-pixel snow falling through the slot against banded violet night, a thin white line of it settled along one dome rib, more lying on the boards below
SNOW SETTLING THICK: fat pixel snowflakes drifting steadily in through the slot, the white line along one rib grown thick, a soft small drift spread across the boards below the opening
RAIN SLANTING IN: fine rain slanting in through the slot and landing in bright rings in a bucket set exactly right below, the boards dark and shining where rain has reached the floor
RAIN AND BRIGHT RINGS: fine rain coming in through the slot at a lean, each drop landing in a bright flat ring in the bucket below, the boards around it dark and wet and gleaming
RAIN IN THE BUCKET: fine slanting rain through the open slot, landing in quick bright rings in a bucket placed exactly right, the boards dark where rain has got in past the bucket's edge
WIND AND RAIN TOGETHER: fine rain slanting hard through the slot, landing in overlapping bright rings in the bucket below, the boards dark and shining in a wide patch around it
